sentences.en: This week's Sunday Read is a story I wrote for the magazine about that family, the Wildensteins of New York and France.
sentences.zh: 本周的“星期日阅读”是我为杂志写的一篇关于那个家族的故事，即来自纽约和法国的维尔登斯坦家族。

sentences.en: It's a look at how the art world can aid and abet tax evasion and money laundering for very high-net-worth people.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于艺术界如何协助和教唆超高净值人群逃税和洗钱的观察。

sentences.en: Oligarchs, billionaires, and allegedly this one family, who have managed to accumulate enormous wealth by quietly buying up huge swaths of masterpieces
sentences.zh: 寡头、亿万富翁，据称还有这个家族，他们通过默默买入大量杰作，

sentences.en: and holding them in tax havens.
sentences.zh: 并将它们存放在避税天堂，从而积累了巨大的财富。

sentences.en: Paintings by Monet, Cézanne, Gauguin, stashed away in freeports that look like prisons full of unimaginable amounts of art.

sentences.en: This is a story of tax evasion on a billion-dollar scale, potentially.
sentences.zh: 这是一个潜在规模达数十亿美元的逃税故事。

sentences.en: And it's culminating in an explosive trial this month before France's highest court.
sentences.zh: 这将在本月法国最高法院的一场爆炸性审判中达到高潮。

sentences.zh: 但这个特殊的故事始于2001年西尔维娅·维尔登斯坦的丈夫丹尼尔去世。

sentences.en: Daniel, at this point in time, is the patriarch of this empire.
sentences.zh: 此时的丹尼尔是这个帝国的大家长。

sentences.en: And when he dies, his two sons,
sentences.zh: 当他去世时，他的两个儿子，

sentences.zh: 也就是西尔维娅的继子们，告诉西尔维娅，实际上他破产了。

sentences.en: And she was going to be financially ruined too, unless she renounced her inheritance.
sentences.zh: 除非她放弃继承权，否则她也会在财务上破产。

sentences.en: Sylvia's been with her husband and stepsons for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娅和她的丈夫及继子们在一起40年了。

sentences.en: She fully trusts them.
sentences.zh: 她完全信任他们。

sentences.en: So she signs the documents they give her, even the ones that are in Japanese.

sentences.en: And then, suddenly, a painting on her wall disappears.
sentences.zh: 然后，突然之间，她墙上的一幅画消失了。

sentences.en: She stops being invited to the family vacation homes.
sentences.zh: 她不再被邀请去家族的度假屋。

sentences.en: Her stepsons tell her she has to move apartments.
sentences.zh: 她的继子们告诉她必须搬公寓。

sentences.en: Everything she's taken for granted is going away.
sentences.zh: 她理所当然拥有的一切都将不复存在。

sentences.en: And she realizes, finally, she's been deceived.
sentences.zh: 她终于意识到，自己被骗了。

sentences.en: So she hires a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 于是她雇了一名律师。

sentences.en: And together, they begin to unravel the magnitude of this family's wealth.
sentences.zh: 他们一起开始揭开这个家族惊人财富的冰山一角。

sentences.zh: 维尔登斯坦家族声称，

sentences.zh: 西尔维娅和她的律师一起发现，维尔登斯坦家族有如此多的资产被隐藏在离岸信托和避税天堂中。

sentences.en: And when she dies, she actually leaves in her will that she wants this fight to continue.
sentences.zh: 当她去世时，她在遗嘱中明确表示希望这场斗争继续下去。

sentences.en: It was her life's mission at that point to untangle the Wildensteins' financial empire.
sentences.zh: 理清维尔登斯坦家族的金融帝国在当时是她一生的使命。

sentences.en: Danielle Wildenstein, gray-suited with a cane in the stands, and Sylvia Roth Wildenstein, a former model with a cigarette dangling from her lips.

sentences.zh: 他们于1964年首次相遇，当时她在巴黎走高级定制时装秀，而他则深陷于与另一个富裕犹太家族的权宜婚姻中，
